text: All afternoon, Sprout was quiet. Even Springs couldn't think of anything to say. And that almost never happens.
Sprout? You don't have to be a tree today. You can just be Sprout.
But if I'm a tree, one day I'll have to stay in one place. And you'll hop away. And Digs will dig away.
And I'd hop back. I always hop back. Ask anybody.
Hello, everyone. I heard someone new down here.
Glo! This is Sprout. Sprout woke up today.
Welcome, Sprout. I'm Glo. I keep watch over the forest at night.
For a long time, yes. Everyone was asleep while I was awake.
Sometimes. But I'll tell you a secret. I was never really alone. Come with me. I'll show you.
